title: Scripture is first principle with Christians; Walaeus's three argument kinds against the atheist
pass_a_gloss: What then, Miletus? If we asserted this principle as simply first, your accusation would have color. But ours establish sacred scripture only as the first principle of any theological discourse undertaken with him who professes himself a Christian and admits both testaments. What process is to be instituted with an utter atheist, Aph. 13 showed. Walaeus wisely reduces all things to three genera of arguments: first from the notes and criteria by which the faith of any history is accustomed to be explored; second from the perfection and divinity of the religion contained in the books of both Testaments, declared by three infallible notes; third from certain signs of divinity — miracles, matter, form, effects, adjuncts of antiquity and duration — from which the divinity of these books becomes known to anyone who seriously girds himself to their reading with a sincere mind studious of his own salvation.
pass_b_english: What then, Miletus? If we made this principle simply first against every adversary, your charge would have some color. But ours set Sacred Scripture only as the first principle of theological discourse with one who professes himself a Christian and admits both Testaments. Against an utter atheist — still empty of Christ's Spirit ([[John 14:17 >> Bible:John 14:17]]) — the process is Aph. XIII's.

Walaeus wisely reduces convincing such a one to three kinds: (1) historical notes and criteria (Arrian; Josephus against Apion) — far more evident in sacred history than in human writings; (2) the religion's perfection and divinity in the Testaments, by three infallible notes — true God alone worshipped, true way of reconciliation, true duties to God and neighbor; (3) certain divinity-signs — miracles; matter (creation, Trinity, Christ God-man, resurrection, judgment, Decalogue, prayer, prophecies, promises); form (simplicity with majesty); effects (cessation of oracles, conversion of nations); adjuncts of antiquity and duration against Satan's hatreds. From these the books' divinity becomes known to anyone who seriously reads them with a sincere mind eager for salvation.
source_text: Nostri scripturam primum principium discursus theologici cum Christiano statuunt; cum atheo processus aph. 13. Walaeus tria genera: historica κριτήρια; perfection/divinity religionis tribus notis; signa divinitatis (miracula, materia, forma, effecta, adjuncta antiquitatis/durationis).
